@ai-ecoverse/wasi-gh.label: GitHub CLI
notes: In seven, use GH_TOKEN from the vault: gh auth login stores a plain-text token.
A git credential helper using gh auth git-credential gets no token.

@ai-ecoverse/wasi-slicc.label: slicc
notes: For root and cones. The other seven must allow remote control from this one in its Linked devices.

slicc-py-datatools.label: Python data tools
slicc-py-datatools.description: numpy, pandas, matplotlib and scipy for Python, about 240 MB on disk.
notes: scipy lacks only the deprecated scipy.odr.

@ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh.label: Node.js (jsh)
notes: No fork, worker or asymmetric crypto yet.

@ai-ecoverse/sliccy-browser.label: Browser for jsh scripts
notes: Seven's own tab and the vault stay out of reach.

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-ruby.label: Ruby
notes: Commands from gem install run by name in a login shell.

@ai-ecoverse/wasm-sqlite3.label: SQLite
notes: journal_mode=WAL falls back to delete, and a WAL database made elsewhere opens as "file is not a database".

@ai-ecoverse/wasix-websocat.label: websocat
notes: An upstream alpha. It speaks raw TCP, so hosts outside seven need an exit: a linked slicc CLI or a Tailscale exit node.
A listener that can't bind still exits 0.

@ai-ecoverse/wasi-ntfy.label: ntfy
notes: Works with ntfy.sh, any ntfy server and the tray's webhook gateway, ntfy.sliccy.ai.

@ai-ecoverse/mcpcat.label: mcpcat (MCP client)
notes: -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${NAME}' (single quotes) sends the vault's placeholder, which the vault fills in where a secret rule allows that host; mcpcat never prints the value.

@ai-ecoverse/wasm-zip.label: zip
notes: unzip refuses an entry whose name isn't UTF-8 (an old Latin-1 or CP437 archive) and extracts the rest (homescoop#1174).
